nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $\mathrm{ped}(n)$ is the number of partitions of $n$ in which every even part occurs exactly once; the odd parts are unrestricted.
nodes.title: Partitions whose even parts are distinct

nodes.summary: The number $\operatorname{ped}(0)$ of partitions of $0$ in which no even part is repeated, the number $\operatorname{pod}(0)$ of partitions of $0$ in which no odd part is repeated, the number $P_2(0)$ of partitions of $0$ with no part congruent to $2$ modulo $4$, and the number $q(0)$ of ordered pairs of partitions into distinct parts with sizes adding up to $0$ are all equal to $1$, as only the empty partition (or…
nodes.title: Values at zero of the restricted partition counts

nodes.summary: Let $\operatorname{ped}(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$ in which no even part is repeated. For every $n \ge 0$, the sum $\sum_j (-1)^j \operatorname{ped}(n - 2j^2)$ over the integers $j$ with $2j^2 \le n$ equals $1$ if $n = k(k+1)/2$ for some integer $k \ge 0$, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Merca's square recurrence for partitions with distinct even parts

nodes.summary: Let $\operatorname{ped}(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$ in which no even part is repeated. For every $n \ge 0$, the sum $\sum_{j \ge 0} (-1)^{\lceil j/2 \rceil} \operatorname{ped}(n - j(j+1)/2)$ over the $j$ with $j(j+1)/2 \le n$ equals $1$ if $n = k(k+1)$ for some integer $k \ge 0$, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Merca's triangular recurrence for partitions with distinct even parts

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $\mathrm{pod}(n)$ is the number of partitions of $n$ in which every odd part occurs exactly once; the even parts are unrestricted.
nodes.title: Partitions whose odd parts are distinct

nodes.summary: Let $\operatorname{pod}(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$ in which no odd part is repeated. For every $n > 0$, the sum $\sum_{k \ge 0} \operatorname{pod}(n - k(k+1)/2)$ over the $k$ with $k(k+1)/2 \le n$ is even.
nodes.title: Evenness of a triangular sum of partition counts with distinct odd parts

nodes.summary: Let $\operatorname{pd}(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$ into distinct parts. For a natural number $n$, $q(n)$ is the number of ordered pairs of partitions into distinct parts whose sizes add up to $n$, that is, $q(n) = \sum_{k=0}^{n} \operatorname{pd}(k) \operatorname{pd}(n-k)$.
nodes.title: Bipartitions into distinct parts

nodes.summary: Let $q(n)$ be the number of ordered pairs of partitions into distinct parts whose sizes add up to $n$, and let $p(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$. For every $n \ge 0$, $q(n) = \sum_{k \ge 0} p(n - k(k+1)/2)$, where the sum runs over the $k$ with $k(k+1)/2 \le n$.
nodes.title: Bipartitions into distinct parts from the partition function

nodes.summary: Let $\operatorname{pd}(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$ into distinct parts. For every $n \ge 0$, the sum $\sum_k (-1)^k \operatorname{pd}(n - k(3k+1))$ over the integers $k$ with $k(3k+1) \le n$ equals $1$ if $n = m(m+1)/2$ for some integer $m \ge 0$, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Pentagonal recurrence for partitions into distinct parts

nodes.summary: Let $\operatorname{pdo}(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$ into distinct odd parts. For every $n \ge 0$, the sum $\sum_k (-1)^k \operatorname{pdo}(n - k(3k+1))$ over the integers $k$ with $k(3k+1) \le n$ equals $(-1)^{\lceil m/2 \rceil}$ if $n = m(3m+1)/2$ for some integer $m$, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Pentagonal recurrence for partitions into distinct odd parts

nodes.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(m)$ be the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $\mathrm{pod}(m)$ the number of partitions of $m$ whose odd parts are distinct. For every natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(n) = \sum_k \mathrm{pod}(n - k(k+1)/2)$, the sum running over the natural numbers $k$ with $k(k+1)/2 \le n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions into odd parts from partitions with distinct odd parts

nodes.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(m)$ be the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $\overline{p}(m)$ the number of overpartitions of $m$. For every natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(n) = \sum_k (-1)^k \, \overline{p}(n - 2k^2)$, the sum running over the integers $k$ with $2k^2 \le n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions into odd parts from overpartitions and squares

nodes.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(m)$ be the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $p(m)$ the number of partitions of $m$. For every natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(n) = \sum_k (-1)^{\lceil k/2 \rceil} p(n - k(3k+1)/2)$, the sum running over the integers $k$ with $k(3k+1)/2 \le n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions into odd parts from partitions and pentagonal numbers

nodes.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(m)$ be the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $P_2(m)$ the number of partitions of $m$ with no part congruent to $2$ modulo $4$. For every natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(n) = \sum_k P_2(n - k(k+1)/2)$, the sum running over the natural numbers $k$ with $k(k+1)/2 \le n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions into odd parts from partitions with no part congruent to 2 modulo 4

nodes.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(m)$ be the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $\overline{p}(m)$ the number of overpartitions of $m$. For every natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(2n) = \overline{p}(n) + 2 \sum_k \overline{p}(n - 2k^2)$, the sum running over the integers $k \ge 1$ with $2k^2 \le n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions of even numbers into odd parts

nodes.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(m)$ be the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $\overline{p}(m)$ the number of overpartitions of $m$. For every natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(2n+1) = 2 \sum_k \overline{p}(n - 2k(k+1))$, the sum running over the natural numbers $k$ with $2k(k+1) \le n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions of odd numbers into odd parts

nodes.summary: The number $\mathrm{po}(0)$ of overpartitions of $0$ into odd parts equals $1$: the empty overpartition is the only one.
nodes.title: Overpartitions of zero into odd parts

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(n)$ is the number of overpartitions of $n$ all of whose parts are odd.
nodes.title: Overpartitions into odd parts

nodes.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(j)$ be the number of overpartitions of $j$ into odd parts. For every natural number $n$, the sum $\sum_k (-1)^k \, \mathrm{po}(n - k(3k+1)/2)$ over the integers $k$ with $k(3k+1)/2 \le n$ equals $(-1)^{\lceil m/2 \rceil}$ if $n = m(3m+1)/2$ for some integer $m$, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Pentagonal recurrence for overpartitions into odd parts

nodes.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(m)$ be the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $\mathrm{pdo}(m)$ the number of partitions of $m$ into distinct odd parts. For every natural number $n$, the sum $\sum_k (-1)^k \, \mathrm{po}(n - k(3k+1)/2)$ over the integers $k$ with $k(3k+1)/2 \le n$ equals the sum $\sum_k (-1)^k \, \mathrm{pdo}(n - k(3k+1))$ over the integers $k$ with $k(3k+1) \le n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions into odd parts and partitions into distinct odd parts

nodes.summary: Write $\mathrm{po}(m)$ for the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts. For every natural number $n$, the sum $\mathrm{po}(n) + 2 \sum_{k \ge 1,\ 2k^2 \le n} (-1)^k \, \mathrm{po}(n - 2k^2)$ equals $1$ if $n = 0$, equals $2$ if $n = m^2$ for some integer $m \ge 1$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Square recurrence for overpartitions into odd parts

nodes.summary: Write $\mathrm{po}(m)$ for the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts. For every natural number $n$, the sum $\sum_{k \ge 0,\ k(k+1)/2 \le n} (-1)^{\lceil k/2 \rceil} \, \mathrm{po}(n - k(k+1)/2)$ equals $1$ if $n = m(m+1)/2$ for some natural number $m$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Triangular recurrence for overpartitions into odd parts

nodes.summary: Write $\mathrm{po}(m)$ for the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $\mathrm{pd}(m)$ for the number of partitions of $m$ into distinct parts. For every natural number $n$, $\sum_{k \ge 0,\ k(k+1)/2 \le n} (-1)^{\lceil k/2 \rceil} \, \mathrm{po}(n - k(k+1)/2) = \sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z},\ k(3k+1) \le n} (-1)^k \, \mathrm{pd}(n - k(3k+1))$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions into odd parts and partitions into distinct parts

nodes.summary: Write $p(m)$ for the number of partitions of $m$. For every positive integer $n$, the sum $\sum_{k \in \mathbb{Z},\ k(3k+1)/2 \le n} p(n - k(3k+1)/2)$ is even.
nodes.title: Parity form of Euler's pentagonal recurrence

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $P_2(n)$ is the number of partitions of $n$ none of whose parts is congruent to $2$ modulo $4$.
nodes.title: Partitions with no part congruent to 2 modulo 4

nodes.summary: Write $P_2(m)$ for the number of partitions of $m$ with no part congruent to $2$ modulo $4$. For every positive integer $n$, the sum $\sum_{k \ge 0,\ k(k+1)/2 \le n} P_2(n - k(k+1)/2)$ is even.
nodes.title: Parity of a triangular sum of partitions with no part congruent to 2 modulo 4

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
